journey.centralWish:
{shortName}, on your birthday, my prayer is that the year ahead brings you peace, good health, and happiness you can feel in the smallest moments. 🌸

May Kanha and Radha Rani bless you with clarity in your choices and courage to follow what feels right to you. May Ganpati Bappa bless your beginnings and give you strength through the challenges along the way.

I hope this year brings you people around whom you feel comfortable being yourself.
Work that makes your efforts feel worthwhile.
Time for your family, your interests, and your dreams.
And quiet evenings when your heart feels at ease.

May you find the courage to try something you have been hoping to begin, the patience to learn, and the kindness to appreciate your own progress.

When a day feels uncertain, may you find understanding and support. When something wonderful happens, may you have people beside you who are delighted to celebrate it.

I hope there are favourite songs, unexpected laughs, meaningful conversations, and ordinary afternoons you remember fondly.

Above all, may you have the freedom to grow at your own pace and build a life that feels right to you.

Happy Birthday, {shortName}. 🦚🌷

May you and your family have many reasons to smile in the year ahead.

With heartfelt wishes,
{sender}

draft.name: ANU PATEL
draft.headline: Happy Birthday, {name}! May your year bloom with peace and happiness. 🌸
draft.intro: Welcome, Anu. 🌷 A little garden of birthday wishes, quiet prayers, and small surprises awaits you. Explore at your own pace—each corner holds a wish for your happiness.
draft.letter:
Dear {shortName},

Happy Birthday. 🌸

While making this little garden, I kept coming back to one thought: what could I wish for you that would still matter after your birthday was over?

My answer was peace, good health, and happiness that feels natural to you.

Our conversations may have been few, but they have meant something to me. I remember your honesty, your wish to remain loyal to your future life partner, and the faith with which you spoke about leaving the unknown to Kanha and Radha Rani. I respect those things about you.

Today, I simply want to celebrate your birthday and wish you well.

May Kanha and Radha Rani bless you with clarity when you have decisions to make, strength when something feels difficult, and people with whom you can comfortably be yourself.

May Ganpati Bappa bless your beginnings and give you patience for the things that take time.

I hope this year brings opportunities that excite you. I hope your efforts lead somewhere meaningful, and that you can recognise your own progress—even when it happens quietly.

I hope there is plenty of laughter, too. The kind that interrupts a serious conversation, makes an ordinary afternoon memorable, and leaves you smiling again later.

May you make happy memories with your family, find comfort in your friendships, and have enough time for the things you enjoy.

And when life feels uncertain, I hope you feel free to take your time. You deserve to make your own choices, follow your own hopes, and discover what feels right for you.

This garden is a small way of putting those wishes into something you can explore. There is no perfect order and no hurry. Take a look around whenever you feel like it, and enjoy whichever little surprises make you smile.

If you return to it another day, I hope you find a sentence or a prayer that brings you a little comfort.

For today, I hope you feel celebrated. I hope someone makes you laugh, your favourite food finds its way onto your plate, and the day gives you a memory you will want to keep.

Happy Birthday, {shortName}. 🦚🌷

May the year ahead bring good health, a peaceful heart, and many reasons to be glad.
draft.finalMessage:
One last birthday wish for you, {shortName}. 🌸

May Kanha and Radha Rani bless the hopes you hold close to your heart. May Ganpati Bappa guide your new beginnings, and may the coming year bring health and happiness to you and your family.

I hope you discover something you love doing, visit somewhere you have wanted to go, and make memories that still bring a smile months later.

Enjoy your day, take your time with your wishes, and choose the paths that feel right for you.

Happy Birthday, {shortName}. 🦚✨

With warm wishes,
{sender}
